prompt: Coached in the 2023/24 season by Dusty May, this college basketball player was the 2023/24 co-winner of the AAC Player of the Year Award. Who is that player?
answer: The player was **Johnell Davis of Florida Atlantic**. He shared the 2023–24 AAC Player of the Year award with **Chris Youngblood** of South Florida while coached by Dusty May.
